records.title: Two-Stage 3D Coronary Artery Segmentation via Multi-View Attention and UA-Mamba Refinement.
records.verified_abstract:
Accurate segmentation of coronary arteries in 3D CCTA remains challenging due to complex vessel topology, sparse small branches, and low contrast in pathological regions. We propose a two-stage segmentation system that combines a Multi-View Attention U-Net (MUNet) and a lightweight Coordinate-Attention network (FANet) for complementary pre-segmentation, followed by a UA-Mamba refinement network that processes voxel blocks using a state-space Mamba encoder and multi-scale channel attention fusion.
MUNet fuses multi-plane local features with a self-attention global branch; FANet preserves positional cues via coordinate attention while remaining computationally light. UA-Mamba refines pre-segmentation by focusing on candidate blocks and modeling long-range dependencies efficiently. On the ImageCAS dataset, the proposed twostage system achieves a Dice of 84.79 %, outperforming single-stage baselines. Results indicate improved branch continuity and reduced background false positives.
The code is available on https://github.com/IMCTGD/MUnet.

records.title: When Specialization Helps (and Hurts): Cross-Modality Transfer in Ophthalmic Imaging with Foundation Models.
records.verified_abstract: Large publicly available datasets for specialized medical imaging are rare, limiting model development and motivating knowledge transfer from related, data-rich modalities. We explore this in ophthalmology by investigating whether retinal foundation models (FMs) pretrained on Color Fundus Photographs (CFP) transfer more effectively to other ophthalmic modalities, specifically Fluorescein Angiography (FA) and Indocyanine Green Angiography (ICGA), than nonspecialist FMs trained on natural images. In particular, we examine how the Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) strategy and model size influence this transfer. Using the public AngioReport dataset, six FMs were fine-tuned on three angiography tasks and thoroughly evaluated. Attention-based analyses, performed both quantitatively and qualitatively, further contextualized the results. Our experiments show that cross-modality transfer in retinal FMs is critically dependent on the SSL method applied during the pretraining phase: while DINOv2 and Token-Reconstruction objectives preserve diverse representations that generalize well across modalities, MAE pretraining leads to overspecialization, a narrowing of representations that limits transferability to other retinal imaging domains.

records.title: Semantic-Guided 3D CT Generation for Stroke Lesion Segmentation.
records.verified_abstract:
Lesion segmentation in non-contrast CT (NCCT) images is crucial for stroke management. However, stroke annotation on NCCT requires extensive time and expertise, resulting in data scarcity and thereby limiting segmentation model performance. While diffusion models have become widely used in medical image generation to mitigate data scarcity, significant challenges remain in generating high-quality 3D volumes and incorporating semantic constraints.
To address these challenges, we propose a novel semantic-guided latent diffusion model (LDM) for NCCT synthesis. Our Semantic-guided 3D CT Generation (SCTG) model leverages semantic features extracted from both images and annotations using DINOv2 to guide the diffusion process, generating 3D NCCT images that correspond to specified stroke lesions.
We also present a Spatial-Semantic Feature Interaction Module (SSFIM) that integrates semantic features into LDM, incorporating adapters to facilitate semantic information in guiding the generation process. Experimental results show that (1) SCTG outperforms existing conditional generation methods qualitatively and quantitatively for image synthesis, and (2) incorporating our generated data improves NCCT-based stroke lesion segmentation performance by up to 22% in Dice score.

records.title: Toward Achieving Adjustable Smoothing Level in Cardiac-Gated SPECT Studies with a Deep Learning Denoising Network.
records.verified_abstract:
Post-reconstruction filtering is essential for suppressing the elevated imaging noise in cardiac-gated SPECT acquisitions, where the smoothing level often needs to be adjusted to better accommodate inter-subject variability in acquired data statistics.
In this study we investigate the feasibility of achieving an adjustable smoothing level by employing a pre-trained deep learning (DL) denoising network for processing cardiac-gated images, the purpose being to avoid the need to re-train the DL network when the desired smoothing level varies for a given patient. We evaluated the performance of this approach on a set of 30 clinical gated acquisitions using a DL network pre-trained from the ungated data of 862 studies.
The results demonstrated that, in terms of the noise level in the reconstructed myocardium and the image resolution of the left ventricle, the proposed approach could achieve almost identical performance compared to retraining the DL network for a desired target smoothing level.

records.title: CBCT-Pose: Few-Shot Viewpoint-Conditioned Diffusion for Sparse-View CBCT Reconstruction.
records.verified_abstract: We present CBCT-Pose, a diffusion-based framework for sparse-view cone-beam CT (CBCT) reconstruction and novel view synthesis from a number of limited projections. Unlike prior approaches that suffer from view inconsistency, CBCTPose fine-tunes a pretrained viewpoint-conditioned diffusion model using few-shot learning to adapt it to X-ray imaging geometry. This generative model is conditioned on three priors: (1) condition views to preserve attenuation information, (2) edge maps as structural guidance for anatomical consistency, and (3) viewpoint transformations to ensure geometric accuracy. Synthesized novel views are fused with real projections and reconstructed via a Neural Attenuation Field (NAF) for improved structural fidelity. Extensive experiments show that CBCT-Pose achieves the state-of-the-art performance in ultra-sparse settings, significantly enhancing image fidelity and 3D reconstruction quality in terms of PSNR, SSIM, and volumetric metrics.
records.scientific_rationale: 初筛漏筛补录。少样本微调位姿条件扩散模型生成稀疏CBCT新投影，再以神经衰减场重建三维影像。
